action_description: a fast 2-hit sword combo seen from behind, the character keeps his back to the camera and attacks AWAY from the camera, toward the top of the picture: (1) he steps forward (up the screen) and slashes the sword in a wide horizontal arc in front of him from right to left; (2) straight from there he raises the sword and chops down hard in front of him, then returns to his ready stance. Quick wind-up and clear follow-through, the red scarf-cape whips with the motion. A bright white-blue slash arc follows the blade on each swing, in front of him (above him on the screen). Keep the back view in every frame, do not turn sideways or toward the camera, same size, no smoke, no dust.
